name: Constant-Stabilized Maximum-Parent Auxiliary Count
definition: For a nonempty proper maximum-generated class $C\subsetneq\{0,1\}^X$, set $b(C)=a(C\times\{0\})$. Equivalently, $b(C)=\min_{(r,s)\in\mathcal F(C)}\max\{r,r+s+1-|X|\}$.
normalization: One visible constant coordinate is adjoined before minimizing the number of auxiliary coordinates; adjoining any positive number of visible constants gives the same value.
comments: It satisfies $a(C)\le b(C)\le a(C)+m(C)$ and is subadditive under Cartesian products.
